notes: The manifest is durable runtime configuration. The stable server only interprets route/source/style/script metadata; all page-owned code remains on runtime. Add, change, or remove routes and assets here without a Vercel deployment. Ice Dragon is an opt-in chat theme; Default remains the first-load selection and the user's explicit choice is persisted locally. Mobile Chat uses a viewport correction plus a final responsive polish layer so normal mobile mode, browser desktop-site mode, message cards, code blocks, and composer geometry stay within the usable viewport without clipping or dead space.
